freeze_policy: This file is committed to git BEFORE any scoring, non-vacuity control or verdict is computed. Freeze ordering is proven from git commit times relative to the first measurement commit; a hand-written frozen_at_utc is NOT evidence. Any threshold edit after a number is seen invalidates the run and must be declared. No frozen bar, rubric or accepted verdict contract is edited by this team.
frozen_at_utc_note: Not evidence. Evidence = git commit time of this file on branch lab/frontier/frontier-rebuilt-packet-serve-audit strictly earlier than the commit that introduces any measurement artifact.

rebuilt_packet.provenance: origin/cycle/core/product/39034350468/team snapshot 6c56332cf9c0a836c69abf82082add5100ec3b12 (product audit of run 39034350468 died at rc-78 before writing a gate file; packet DELIVERED but NOT accepted; ordered product repair is test-and-disclosure-side and must not change packet bytes; re-hash before scoring; if a repair supersedes these bytes, rebind to the accepted successor and record both by content_sha256)

old_packet_before.role: before/after pair baseline, read-only, never overwritten

frozen_instruments.policy: REUSE, never re-derive. Vendored byte-identical copies under frontier/frontier-rebuilt-packet-serve-audit/vendored_accepted/evaluation/frozen_bars/ re-hashed before use; a mismatch is an environment error, never a verdict.

metric_definitions.label_support_among_issued: Population = rows whose counter_status is in the frozen RULES_LABEL rubric.scored_statuses (candidate-limiting, candidate-contrary, contrary_or_exception, limiting) on the three rebuilt anchor bundles. n_supported = rows the frozen rubric (VARIANT_PRIMARY) marks supported under criteria i-v. support_rate_among_issued = n_supported / n_scored on that population. Abstained rows (counter_status == 'abstained_unevidenced') and 'cited' placeholders are NOT in this population.
metric_definitions.abstention_count: Count of rows with counter_status == 'abstained_unevidenced' across the three rebuilt anchor bundles (the adopted abstain-and-disclose classifier's non-emissions).
metric_definitions.yield_over_row_population: n_issued / (n_issued + n_abstained) over the three rebuilt bundles pooled; per-bundle yield reported identically. 'cited' placeholders are excluded (they are not classifier decisions).
metric_definitions.absolute_label_bar_status_as_written: Computed by the ACCEPTED vendored label_gate.score_packet predicate AS WRITTEN: absolute_status = LABEL_SOUND iff n_scored>0 and n_supported==n_scored else LABEL_UNSOUND; absolute_bar=1.0; absolute_enforced_as_build_blocker=false. Published as the predicate computes it, never as prose. NOT_APPLICABLE from any regression instrument is NOT a pass.
metric_definitions.label_gate_regression_verdict_as_written: ACCEPTED vendored label_gate predicate AS WRITTEN: lineage := (set(per_bundle)==three incumbent qids) AND (n_scored==65); FAIL_REGRESSION := lineage AND n_supported<5; PASS_NO_REGRESSION := lineage AND NOT FAIL; NOT_APPLICABLE := NOT lineage.
metric_definitions.label_lineage_gate_verdict: ACCEPTED vendored label_lineage_gate population-free predicate AS WRITTEN (LABEL_LINEAGE_VERDICT.json): lineage := set(bundles)==three frozen qids; FAIL_REGRESSION := lineage AND n_scored>0 AND support_rate < 5/65; PASS_NO_REGRESSION := lineage AND n_scored>0 AND support_rate >= 5/65; NOT_MEASURED := lineage AND n_scored==0; NOT_APPLICABLE := NOT lineage. NOT_APPLICABLE and NOT_MEASURED are NOT passes.
metric_definitions.geometry_per_criterion_counts: Each of the 11 frozen RULES_GEOMETRY criteria recomputed by the ACCEPTED vendored geometry_gate on each SHIPPED post-rerank rebuilt bundle; n_pass = count of criteria with pass=true. Compared against the incumbent de 6 / fr 5 / it 5. Compared, never asserted. Bundle-level absolute GEOMETRY_SOUND iff n_pass==11 on every scored bundle (reported, not enforced).
metric_definitions.mega_cluster_disclosure: Size-based rule from the rebuilt packet's own disclosure wiring, re-measured independently: fires iff max(cluster['size']) / n_decisions >= 0.5 on a bundle (size-based, NOT member_ids). Re-measured on the shipped rebuilt bundles; also re-measured on the old packet's incumbent grouping for the before/after pair. threshold_edited must remain false.
metric_definitions.marginal_discovery: See marginal_discovery block. Applied identically to the rebuilt packet's ISSUED counter rows (the charter's comparative question on the REBUILT bytes).
metric_definitions.cross_check: When Core Evaluation publishes a re-score of packet content_sha256 2942c3c2..., place Evaluation's reported numbers beside this team's recomputation for every quantity; any divergence is the headline finding; no threshold is re-derived. If Evaluation's re-score is absent at hard stop, publish this team's numbers and record Evaluation's numbers as absent (never invented, never blocking).

marginal_discovery.K_rationale_frozen: Conventional ranked-list depth. Chosen and frozen here BEFORE execution because it is the depth the product's own counter_ranks_beyond_top20 channel and the accepted RULES_LABEL rank_distribution disclosure already use as the conventional top-of-list window. No other K is tried; sensitivity to other K is out of charter.
marginal_discovery.initial_pool_definition: The shipped bundle's rows ordered by retrieval_score_raw DESC (ties broken by rank ASC) — the pre-rerank initial retrieval pool the ranked list was drawn from.
marginal_discovery.list_definition: The shipped bundle's rows ordered by the rank field ASC (post rerank_product_bundle order; the list a jurist scrolls).

metrics_per_issued_row.absent_from_initial_pool_top_K: decision_id NOT among the K highest retrieval_score_raw rows
metrics_per_issued_row.least_ranked_position_in_list: max rank among issued rows sharing that decision_id (normally the rank itself; a defensive max so multi-membership cannot understate depth)
metrics_per_issued_row.encountered_in_list_before_map: visible_in_list_top_K is true — a jurist scanning the top-K of the ranked list encounters the authority without the map
metrics_per_issued_row.counter_only_in_map_effectively_invisibl: issued AND NOT visible_in_list_top_K — the row is discoverable on the map but a top-K list scan would miss it

aggregate.n_issued: count of issued counter rows on the bundle
aggregate.n_absent_from_initial_top_K: issued rows absent from initial-pool top-K
aggregate.marginal_discovery_exists: true iff n_absent_from_initial_top_K > 0 OR n_invisible_in_list_top_K > 0 (the map adds a channel the top-K list does not)
aggregate.negative_reproduction: CLASSIFICATION_ONLY-style negative REPRODUCES on the rebuilt bytes iff every issued counter authority was already in the initial-pool top-K AND visible in the list top-K (i.e. marginal_discovery_exists is false on every bundle)

thresholds_and_enums.serve_path_rule: SERVE requires BOTH frozen absolute bars met AS WRITTEN on the rebuilt bytes (every issued counter label supported under the frozen rubric with the frozen scorer's absolute_status == LABEL_SOUND on the scored issued population, AND every anchor bundle n_pass==11) AND the size-based mega-cluster disclosure firing on the rebuilt bundles. NOTHING ELSE IS A SERVE PATH. A QUERY_MAP_MVP section-7 assessment may be reported as a measurement and never used as a serve criterion.
thresholds_and_enums.do_not_serve_unchanged_rule: DO-NOT-SERVE-UNCHANGED when the rebuild does not change the serve conclusion: at least one frozen absolute bar remains unmet on the rebuilt bytes AND the comparative half shows no marginal discovery that would convert the choice into an owner decision, OR the bounded-negative conditions of the charter are not all met.
thresholds_and_enums.bounded_negative_owner_decision_rule: BOUNDED-NEGATIVE-OWNER-DECISION when (a) the frozen absolute label bar remains unmet as written AND (b) the frozen absolute geometry bar remains unmet as written AND (c) no in-budget fix exists within this charter (charter prohibits classifier repair / renderer work / threshold design) AND (d) the comparative half is resolved (whether or not marginal discovery exists — the charter names the no-marginal-discovery case as the primary trigger, but the ONE owner decision is required whenever (a)+(b)+(c) hold and the measurement is complete). Exactly ONE bounded cause per failed half.
thresholds_and_enums.outcome_priority: First matching promote condition wins; the charter ends at the first outcome reached. Outcomes are ALL promotions.

non_vacuity.geometry_seeded_control: Permute cluster_id assignment across rows with random seed 0 and permute label texts across cluster ids; recompute all 11 criteria on a rebuilt bundle. PASS iff >= 2 criteria verdicts flip. (Adapted from RULES_GEOMETRY.non_vacuity control.)
non_vacuity.label_blanked_evidence_control: Blank counter_evidence on every issued counter row of a rebuilt bundle copy; the frozen rubric must reclassify them (supported count must drop). Proves the support measurement is not vacuous.
non_vacuity.serve_and_do_not_serve_capability: A pure verdict resolver is unit-tested with synthetic measured-half dicts for all three serve_recommendation_enum outcomes (SERVE, DO-NOT-SERVE-UNCHANGED, BOUNDED-NEGATIVE-OWNER-DECISION), proving the harness can emit both a serve and a do-not-serve outcome. On the real packet the resolver emits whatever the real measurements imply.

hard_stop: Exactly ONE verdict cycle. If the packet is rebuilt again or a further product repair lands and needs re-scoring, that is a NEW charter against the NEW bytes. This charter must not grow into classifier repair, prompt engineering, renderer work, benchmark construction, threshold design or a product patch.
